name: smwmusic-legacy-of-ys-book-i-tower-of-the-shadow-of-death
title: Legacy of Ys: Book I - Tower of the Shadow of Death
description:
This plays during the final dungeon of Ys 1, Darm Tower. It's not a very final-sounding song, but it can definitely work for a tower/castle level in the mountain!

My port is largely based on the DS version of Ys I, hence the title of the submission, but I extended the intro a bit so it stays consistent with the other versions of the song.
